_comment: Octail's own egg (LinuxGSM's ut99server settings and OldUnreal's Linux installer, github.com/OldUnreal/FullGameInstallers, were read as a reference). The game data comes the way OldUnreal's installer gets it: the GOTY CD image OldUnreal hosts with Epic Games' permission (archive.org as the mirror) and Bonus Pack 4, then OldUnreal's patch 469e for Linux x86_64 from GitHub; all three are checked against pinned SHA-256s (the image's and Bonus Pack 4's from OldUnreal's installer, the patch's from GitHub's release digest). Epic Games' Terms of Service apply to the game, so the install downloads nothing until the owner sets Accept Epic Games Terms to TRUE (eula_variable: with the host's server_tools.auto_accept_eula on, the panel accepts). The install unpacks the CD's compressed maps with ucc, makes System64/UnrealTournament.ini once from the patch's Default.ini, and the ini parser sets the port, name, message, passwords, the master server uplink and WebAdmin before every start. The map, game type, slots and mutators are on the start line. The Unreal query port (main + 1) is reserved with fixed_ports, WebAdmin is off by default on its own automatic port. The server reads no console input; start line "Game engine initialized" or the game port (UDP) bound; stop with Ctrl+C.
name: Unreal Tournament (1999)
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Unreal Tournament (1999, Game of the Year edition) with OldUnreal's community patch 469: deathmatch, capture the flag, domination, assault and last man standing on the Unreal Engine 1 arena shooter.
startup: [ -x System64/ucc-bin-amd64 ] || { echo "Unreal Tournament is not installed: set Accept Epic Games Terms to TRUE on the Startup tab and reinstall the server."; exit 1; }; cd System64 && exec ./ucc-bin server "{{MAP}}?game={{GAME_TYPE}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}${MUTATORS:+?Mutator=${MUTATORS}}" ini=UnrealTournament.ini log=server.log -nohomedir

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unreal Tournament (1999, GOTY edition) installation script (Octail), the way OldUnreal's own Linux installer
# (github.com/OldUnreal/FullGameInstallers) does it: the game data from the GOTY CD image OldUnreal hosts with Epic
# Games' permission (archive.org as the mirror), Bonus Pack 4, then OldUnreal's patch 469e for Linux x86_64 on top.
# Every file is checked against a pinned SHA-256: the CD image's and Bonus Pack 4's are the ones in OldUnreal's
# installer, the patch's the one GitHub lists for the release asset. Epic Games' Terms of Service apply to the game:
# nothing is downloaded until the server's owner accepts them on the Startup tab. Failures exit non-zero.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

## the CD image and Bonus Pack 4: sizes and SHA-256 from OldUnreal's install-ut99.sh (1.3.1); the patch: OldUnreal's
## v469e release (2025-11-11), Linux amd64, with the SHA-256 GitHub lists for it. A new patch needs both updated here.
ISO=UT_GOTY_CD1.iso
ISO_SHA256=e184984ca88f001c5ddd52035d76cd64e266e26c74975161b5ed72366c74704f
BP4=utbonuspack4-zip.7z
BP4_SHA256=5b7a1080724a122a596c226c50d4dc7c2d7636ceaf067e9c12112014a170ffba
PATCH_VERSION=469e
PATCH=OldUnreal-UTPatch469e-Linux-amd64.tar.bz2
PATCH_SHA256=08c806aa3721b1970045aa158ad90051329d982e8a9a3661153900e9ccbf6b0c
TOS_URL=https://legal.epicgames.com/en-US/epicgames/tos

if [ "${ACCEPT_EPIC_TOS:-FALSE}" != TRUE ]; then
    echo "Unreal Tournament isn't installed yet: the Epic Games Terms of Service apply to the game"
    echo "(${TOS_URL}). Read them, set Accept Epic Games Terms to TRUE on the Startup tab and reinstall."
    exit 1
fi

if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: this egg installs OldUnreal's Linux x86_64 server (this node is $(uname -m))."
    exit 1
fi

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates p7zip-full bzip2 > /dev/null

## downloads and unpacking are staged on the server's own disk (the installer's /tmp may be small), removed afterwards
cd /mnt/server
STAGE=/mnt/server/.octail-install
rm -rf "$STAGE"
mkdir -p "$STAGE"

## fetch <file> <sha256> <url>...: the first mirror whose download matches the checksum wins
fetch() {
    local file=$1 sum=$2 url
    shift 2
    for url in "$@"; do
        echo "Downloading ${url}"
        if curl -fSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 3600 --retry 3 -o "$STAGE/$file" "$url" &&
            echo "${sum}  $STAGE/$file" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
            return 0
        fi
        echo "That download failed or doesn't match its SHA-256; trying the next mirror."
    done
    rm -rf "$STAGE"
    echo "Installation failed: no mirror gave a ${file} matching its SHA-256."
    exit 1
}
fetch "$ISO" "$ISO_SHA256" https://files.oldunreal.net/UT_GOTY_CD1.ISO https://files2.oldunreal.net/UT_GOTY_CD1.ISO \
    https://files3.oldunreal.net/UT_GOTY_CD1.ISO https://archive.org/download/ut-goty/UT_GOTY_CD1.iso
fetch "$BP4" "$BP4_SHA256" https://files.oldunreal.net/utbonuspack4-zip.7z https://files2.oldunreal.net/utbonuspack4-zip.7z \
    https://files3.oldunreal.net/utbonuspack4-zip.7z
fetch "$PATCH" "$PATCH_SHA256" \
    "https://github.com/OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches/releases/download/v${PATCH_VERSION}/${PATCH}"

## the game data from the CD image: maps, music, sounds, textures, web admin pages and the UnrealScript packages
## (System/*.u); not the Windows programs, setup files or the old settings files
7z x -y -bd -o"$STAGE/cd" "$STAGE/$ISO" > /dev/null
rm -f "$STAGE/$ISO"
if [ ! -f "$STAGE/cd/System/Botpack.u" ] || [ ! -d "$STAGE/cd/Maps" ]; then
    rm -rf "$STAGE"
    echo "Installation failed: the game data is missing from ${ISO}."
    exit 1
fi
for DIR in Maps Music Sounds Textures Web Help; do
    mkdir -p "$DIR"
    [ ! -d "$STAGE/cd/$DIR" ] || cp -rlf "$STAGE/cd/$DIR/." "$DIR/"
done
mkdir -p System
cp -lf "$STAGE"/cd/System/*.u System/

## Bonus Pack 4, then the patch on top (binaries in System64/, new packages, translations, web admin)
7z x -y -bd -o/mnt/server "$STAGE/$BP4" > /dev/null
tar -xjf "$STAGE/$PATCH" -C /mnt/server
rm -rf "$STAGE"
if [ ! -x System64/ucc-bin-amd64 ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: System64/ucc-bin-amd64 is missing after unpacking ${PATCH}."
    exit 1
fi
ln -sfn ucc-bin-amd64 System64/ucc-bin
## translations: the patch's SystemLocalized/ replaces older copies in System/
for LOC in SystemLocalized/*/*.*; do
    [ -f "$LOC" ] || continue
    rm -f "System/${LOC##*/}"
done

## the settings file, only when there is none (a reinstall keeps it): made from the patch's Default.ini, as the
## server would make it at its first start, with the web admin's well-known default password removed
if [ ! -f System64/UnrealTournament.ini ]; then
    sed -e 's/^AdminPassword=admin$/AdminPassword=/' System64/Default.ini > System64/UnrealTournament.ini
fi
if [ ! -f System64/User.ini ]; then
    cp System64/DefUser.ini System64/User.ini
fi

## the CD's maps are compressed (.unr.uz): the server only loads them unpacked
echo "Unpacking the maps"
for UZ in Maps/*.unr.uz; do
    [ -f "$UZ" ] || continue
    NAME=$(basename "$UZ" .uz)
    if [ ! -f "Maps/$NAME" ]; then
        if ! OUT=$(cd System64 && ./ucc-bin decompress "../Maps/$NAME.uz" -nohomedir 2>&1) || [ ! -f "System64/$NAME" ]; then
            echo "$OUT" | tail -n 20
            echo "Installation failed: Maps/$NAME.uz couldn't be unpacked."
            exit 1
        fi
        mv -f "System64/$NAME" "Maps/$NAME"
    fi
    rm -f "$UZ"
done
## OldUnreal's installer fix: DM-Cybrosis][ is both a deathmatch and a domination map
if [ -f "Maps/DM-Cybrosis][.unr" ] && [ ! -f "Maps/DOM-Cybrosis][.unr" ]; then
    cp "Maps/DM-Cybrosis][.unr" "Maps/DOM-Cybrosis][.unr"
fi
if [ ! -f "Maps/DM-Deck16][.unr" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: the game's maps are missing."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Unreal Tournament GOTY with OldUnreal's patch ${PATCH_VERSION}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (up to 64 characters, no " or \).

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as DM-Deck16][, DM-Morpheus, CTF-Face, DOM-Sesmar or AS-Frigate (it must suit the game type). Maps you upload go into Maps/.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Botpack.DeathMatchPlus (deathmatch), Botpack.TeamGamePlus (team deathmatch), Botpack.CTFGame (capture the flag), Botpack.Domination, Botpack.Assault, Botpack.LastManStanding, or a mod's game class.

variables.name: Mutators
variables.description: Optional: mutator classes separated by commas, such as Botpack.InstaGibDM,Botpack.LowGrav.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Players must enter it to join; empty for an open server. Letters, digits and _.@%+!- only.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: For adminlogin <password> in the game console and the WebAdmin page (user admin). 8 to 40 letters, digits or _.@%+!-. Hidden once saved.

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Optional: shown to players when they join (no " or \).

variables.name: Public Server List
variables.description: True lists the server on the community master servers (333networks, OldUnreal, OpenSpy, ...); False keeps it off the list (players join by address).

variables.name: WebAdmin
variables.description: True turns on the WebAdmin page on the WebAdmin Port (user admin, the Admin Password).

variables.name: WebAdmin Port
variables.description: The WebAdmin port (TCP). Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Accept Epic Games Terms
variables.description: The Epic Games Terms of Service (https://legal.epicgames.com/en-US/epicgames/tos) apply to the game. TRUE accepts them for this server, and the install then downloads the game data; with FALSE the install stops and downloads nothing. Reinstall after changing it.
